items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 28 July 2026 4:59am
items.description:
##Today##

Largely cloudy morning with just a few outbreaks of light rain or drizzle in places, brighter intervals developing during the afternoon to give some warm sunshine especially in the north of the island.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 15°C and max. air temperature 21°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-1


##Wind Speed##

17


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW 10-15, soon increasing 15-20, then 20-25 for a while later today.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in any rain/drizzle. Hill fog at times.


##Comments##

Locally strong wind later today.


##Tomorrow##

Dry & bright start, then a few showers developing for a while, followed by more general outbreaks of rain late afternoon & during the evening. Becoming dry again overnight.
